scope: Exact actual Human deformed >65%-owned digit/palm vertices plus >50% whole-hand mixed-web vertices against all 88 actual animated key inner boxes. Inner margins 2 mm black / 1.4 mm white, original-box nearest-face depth, >3 mm unchanged failure gate. No finger-pair, pad-ray, 240 Hz, continuous-time or visual approval is performed.
notes: Every >3 mm patch/key failure is retained in whole-song60.json. This index groups those exact rows without changing the threshold.
Intervals join consecutive sampled frame indices only when patch, key, state, note, previous and next event IDs match. They are observed finite intervals, not continuous collision bounds.
Family grouping retains absolute note/key MIDI and supplies a separate key-offset view; wrist and simultaneous-neighbor context can still differ within a family.
